notes.title: Cosmara Build 15
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*]Small delay before spawning with new effects, to prevent players from spawning inside each other
[*]Warp effects for advanced warp drive fixed to not look like the standard one
[*]Added afterburner overheat sound effects and fixed the looping of standard afterburner sound.
[*]New aiming reticle/laser sight for all weapons
[*]Reduced damage of all non-missile/rocket/torpedo type weapons by approximately 50% and increased ammo reserves
[*]Lower damage output of small AI ship's chainguns by about half
[*]Re-Optimised all colliders for ships/asteroids/buildings. This should help with clipping issues and getting stuck in things
[*]New AI behaviors especially in Capture the Station mode, where the AI will seek to capture the zones first as a priority
[*]Optimised the Ai's further
[*]Fixed bug where the player would enter the hangar and get stuck there unable to do anything
[*]Added Team Deathmatch because why not
[*]Added Player progression and cloud saves
[*]Added steam achievements functionality and initial test achievement
[*]New naming system in the hangar for ships, still have to think of all the names though
[*]Bomber ship class added, no ships for it yet. Will be anti-large/slow focused
[*]Large AI ship type added for PVP
[*]Recreated the whole ship template system in the hangar. No longer just 3 save slots!
[*]Updating the effects on missiles/rockets (torpedos next)
[*]And much more that I can't remember...
[/list]

[b]New Ships:[/b]

[list]
[*]Stock Engineer
[*]Engineer Variant B
[*]Engineer Variant C
[*]*Shuffled the old Engineer to be variant A instead of stock.
[/list]

[b]Coming up soon:[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixing shields for non-host players
[*]Fixing auto-flares for non-host players
[*]Client side damage calls instead of host for more accurate damage feedback for clients
[*]Railgun overhaul
[*]New missile/mine types added
[*]Making the settings menu good instead of crud (actually remembering settings)
[/list]
